items.label: Commander assignment
items.description: Assign commanders to Auto Towers in Commanders so the task can use them when they are available.

title: Set scanning, daily limits and travel

items.label: Authoritative map scan · Every
items.description: Choose how often to refresh each castle’s tower list, from 1,800–3,600 seconds; attacks can launch between scans.

items.label: Daily normal-attack limit
items.description: Pauses at your account-wide daily attack limit until the game resets it; 0 removes the limit.

items.label: Horse travel boost
items.description: Uses your selected travel option for each attack, including every hit in an Advisor chain, with speed based on the source castle’s travel buildings.

items.label: Travel feather
items.description: Uses the travel feather option rather than a coin or ruby horse tier.

items.label: Horse / ship tier · coins
items.description: Spends coins on the coin travel tier.

items.label: Warhorse / fast ship tier · rubies
items.description: Spends rubies on the first ruby travel tier when selected.

items.label: Courser / fastest ship tier · rubies
items.description: Spends rubies on the faster ruby travel tier when selected.

image.alt: Auto Towers general settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Set the scan interval, daily attack limit and travel option; Advisor controls appear when available.

items.label: Castle switch
items.description: Turn on each castle you want Auto Towers to scan and attack from.

items.label: Radius
items.description: Choose how far to search around this castle, from 1–50 tiles.

items.label: Choose troop
items.description: Choose the stationed troop to fill both attack flanks; attacks wait if there are too few.

items.label: Maiden-supported only
items.description: Limits this castle to available commanders with the supported maiden relic.

image.alt: Auto Towers castle settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Enable a castle and choose its radius, troop and maiden requirement.

title: Use Advisor if wanted · when available

items.label: Use Advisor with Time Skips
items.description: Repeats hits on one tower, using one daily attack first and one Time Skip of at least three hours per extra hit.

items.label: Auto-activate with token
items.description: Uses an available Baron Advisor token when the Advisor is inactive, without buying a token or spending rubies.

items.label: Maximum daily Time Skips
items.description: Caps Time Skips used by confirmed Advisor chains until the game’s daily attack counter resets; 0 pauses Advisor launches.

title: Set the schedule, save and switch on

items.label: Calendar
items.description: Use Calendar to choose when Auto Towers may run, while troop availability and other limits still apply.

items.label: Save changes
items.description: Select Save changes to apply your settings; reading this guide does not save them.

items.label: Auto Towers switch
items.description: Turn on Auto Towers on the Automation page after saving your settings to allow the task to run.
